item.title: State highways account for the largest share of fatal crashes in the U.S.
item.description: MELBOURNE, Australia – A new nationwide analysis of crash data reveals that state highways – not interstates – account for the largest proportion of deadly road crashes in the United States. The study by iSelect examined 129,825 fatal crashes across all 50 states and Washington, D.C., breaking them down by road type: interstates, U.S. highways, state highways, and local streets.
